title: Magnolia SMP
description: Magnolia is a cozy exploration, building, and farming modpack centered around Create, Farmer's Delight, and a carefully selected collection of world generation, decoration, and immersion mods.
body:
Magnolia is a cozy exploration, building, and farming modpack centered around Create, Farmer's Delight, and a carefully selected collection of world generation, decoration, and immersion mods. Explore overhauled landscapes with Regions Unexplored and Nature's Spirit, encounter new wildlife with Naturalist, expand your fishing experience with Aquaculture 2, build with the Macaw's series, explore with the Let's Do series, discover improved structures from YUNG's Better series, and create everything from simple farms to complex factories using Create.

Mods Required to download:

[FTB Essentials](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ftb-essentials)

[FTB Library](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ftb-library-forge)

[FTB Quests](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ftb-quests-forge)

[FTB Teams](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ftb-teams-forge)

[Simple Voice Chat](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/simple-voice-chat)

[Wabi Sabi Structures](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/wabi-sabi-structures-forge)
